backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no functionality.
feature_evidence.json: Metadata describing feature evidence for publishing Draft Version 10, including related files, components, and tests.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries of various frontend files for documentation or build planning.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT_CHECKLIST_V10.md: Deployment checklist outlining steps, validation, and rollback for promoting Draft Version 10 to production.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base and custom theme variables defining colors, dark mode, and global styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point containing metadata, fonts, and root mount for the React app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React component assembling navigation, marketing sections, and footer into the app layout.
frontend/src/components/marketing/Contac: Contact section with form validation, mailto submission, and contact info cards.
frontend/src/components/marketing/Covera: Coverage section highlighting nationwide service, venue expertise, and experience with a map image.
frontend/src/components/marketing/Footer: Footer with company info, quick links, contact details, and caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/marketing/HeroSe: Hero section with background image, company intro, and CTAs that scroll to the contact section.
frontend/src/components/marketing/Servic: Renders a grid of service cards with icons, descriptions, and background images for the marketing page.
frontend/src/components/marketing/TopNav: Implements a responsive top navigation bar with scroll-based styling and smooth section scrolling.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Provides a hook that creates and manages a backend actor based on Internet Identity authentication status.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity provider and hook managing authentication state, identity loading, and login flows.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Empty placeholder file indicating no backend query hooks are needed.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles, theme variables, typography, and utility classes for the frontend.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, typography, animations, plugins, and component settings.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata including features, versioning, and state configuration.
